correctness.rationale: For integer p>=2 and q>p the claimed candidate is feasible. Exact quotient characteristic factorization and positivity of f(c), f(2-c) give its complete SLEM. At H>=0 the positive Rayleigh/leaf subgradient mixture gives a global lower certificate under both hub constraints, and group averaging extends it to all symmetric stochastic matrices. At H<0 an explicit feasible negative direction lowers both active modes. The threshold is unique because H increases strictly; finite exact-rational and direct spectral checks independently exercise the algebra.

Actual semantic and literature queries yielded no stronger statement. Potential specialized historical treatments remain a risk.

value.rationale: A natural infinite network-design family gains an explicit rational global mixing-rate optimum and transition law. The sharp quartic onset, strict exclusion below onset, and irrational limiting size ratio expose a structural eigenmode change and provide a reproducible design principle. This is not merely another finite numerical example or generic SDP reduction.
